ValidationRule.description: Enforces residential naming standard (Ticket 2.2): accounts are named for the person; sites live in address fields. Fires only on create or when the name is edited, so the 47 legacy "... Residence" accounts stay editable until they are renamed.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Naming standard: use the person's name only, e.g. "Amelia Martin" — not "Amelia Martin Residence". The property belongs in the address fields. One account per household.
